claim: G418 makes ribosomes continue past a premature stop, rather than stalling at it
assay: GSE144140 ribosome profiling, HEK293T, G418 500 ug/mL against DMSO, three replicates each
endpoint: The three-part signature of ADR-0010: downstream in-frame occupancy rises, termination occupancy falls, and downstream frame composition moves toward the library's own coding frame
comparability: Direct. The assay measures ribosome position on endogenous transcripts, which is what the claim is about
detail: All three conditions held, every replicate on the correct side of every control replicate, and the frame interval excluded zero. Confirmatory within one laboratory and protocol family, which is the strongest thing available: the libraries and the sequencing are independent of those that shaped the rule, the protocol is not
what_would_settle_it: A second laboratory with different linker chemistry profiling a readthrough compound at three replicates. No public dataset does this, so the shared-protocol artefact remains unexcluded

claim: SRI-37240 raises occupancy at stop codons without raising occupancy beyond them, so it stalls rather than reads through
assay: GSE144140 ribosome profiling, HEK293T, SRI-37240 10 uM against DMSO, three replicates each
endpoint: The same signature, expected to fail in the direction the mechanism predicts: termination occupancy does not fall and downstream occupancy does not rise
comparability: Direct, and the discriminating case: it shares the assay, the cell line and the laboratory with the positive control
detail: The signature failed as predicted, which is what makes the G418 result a discrimination rather than a response. A rule that fired on both compounds would have demonstrated nothing. Supported under ADR-0010: termination occupancy does not fall and downstream occupancy does not rise. The termination replicate arms overlap, so the supplemental separation diagnostic is not met.
what_would_settle_it: Disome profiling, which would show collision directly rather than by the absence of a downstream signal

claim: A tyrosine suppressor tRNA reads through the IDUA p.Trp402Ter premature stop in patient fibroblasts
assay: GSE179274 ribosome profiling, IDUA-W402X patient fibroblasts, suppressor tRNA against an EGFP delivery control, two replicates each
endpoint: The same three-part signature, unpaired at two replicates per arm
comparability: Direct in principle and inadequate in practice. All four libraries of this contrast calibrate to a valid P-site offset, so nothing is displaced; three of the four fall under the predeclared depth floor
detail: The design could not have resolved the claim whatever it showed. The frame-composition condition, which ADR-0010 makes the load-bearing one, has a minimum detectable effect of 0.393 against a G418-sized reference of 0.181, and 92-98% of the variance sits between libraries rather than in the counts, so no additional sequencing reaches it. This is the only public profiling of a suppressor tRNA and it never had the power to answer
what_would_settle_it: Four libraries per arm rather than two, at the depth already achieved. More reads would not help; replication would. The two G418 contrasts of this dataset are separately unanalysable, on validity rather than power: both untreated libraries infer a P-site offset of 9-10 nt, outside the 11-14 nt window, which displaces an estimate rather than widening it

claim: Ribosome kinetics — how fast each codon is decoded — carries information about drug-induced readthrough beyond the local sequence context the published model already uses
assay: Codon occupancy from GSE144140 DMSO ribosome profiling attached to the Toledano reporter library, six drugs, grouped-by-gene cross-validation against the reproduced baseline
endpoint: Held-out squared Pearson correlation of the kinetic model over the baseline, per drug, with three shuffle controls and a support stratification
comparability: Partial. The occupancy is measured on endogenous transcripts in HEK293T and the labels come from a synthetic reporter in the same cell line, so codon identity and local tRNA demand transfer while initiation rate and upstream density do not, and are out of scope by construction (ADR-0020)
detail: Not supported under the preregistered rule: the gain did not clear all three shuffle controls. The corrected permutation analysis of ADR-0021 says why. Permuting occupancy within synonymous codon families — preserving the amino acid, destroying only the tRNA-level demand the hypothesis names — reproduces a mean maximum gain of +0.00299 against a best observed gain of +0.00356, so the observed value sits inside that null at p = 0.21. The gain is larger than a fully scrambled table gives (global p = 0.020 for SJ6986) and larger than gene composition alone gives (within-gene p = 0.005), so something real is there; the decisive control attributes it to amino-acid identity rather than to decoding demand. The largest gain is under 2% of that drug's remaining reliability headroom
what_would_settle_it: A gain that exceeds the synonymous-permutation null, which is what a positive attribution to decoding demand requires and what this data does not show. Failing to reject that null is not equivalence: an equivalence claim would need a margin declared in advance, which this project has not declared. Disome profiling would separate collision from occupancy, and a reporter library whose members differ synonymously would test the tRNA-level question directly rather than through a permutation
